page.overview:
Who is Amry Talter?

Doctor is a professor and a cleric of the Totality. As an NPC, Amry is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Amry is a halfling woman with a mousy face and brown hair, who wears spectacles as well as a blue and white academic gown and vest.

She is enthusiastic about her field of study and wants to help people with it, although she is also very insecure about the possibility of failure or mistakes.

Amry became a member of the Totality and started dedicating herself to the ideas of knowledge and truth in order to channel that divine domain as a cleric would. As an academic, she also specialised in celestials, being fascinated by their biological origins.
